Esri World_Imagery at 43.8242,-110.3554 (300 m half-width), read 2026-11-20

booking.source: FS page ('These sites are first come, first serve. They cannot be reserved.'); no recreation.gov listing, read 2026-11-20

values.note: Nine sites take 24 ft (two of them pull-throughs: 2 and 6; also 12-18); the other eight take 18 ft. Site 11 is the host's. Two vehicles at most per site.

sites.source: FS page ('This site is equipped with 17 campsites'; 'Parking by site number and RV size accommodations: Site #1 : 18ft / Site #2 : 24ft, Pull Through ... Site #6 : 24ft, Pull Through ... Site #11 : Host Site / Site #12-#18 : 24ft'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Second vehicle extra ($6 in the fee table, $7 in the text); no more than two vehicles a site. No fee after the closure date while services are off.

fees.source: FS page ('Single Site: $15 per night / Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle'; '$15/Night for single unit. $7 fee for extra 2nd vehicle, no more than 2 vehicles/ site'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Services (water, toilets, trash) end on the closure date, but the gate stays open and the campground can be used for free afterwards; in 2026 services ran to 09-24.

season.source: FS page ('Closes September 15 annually'; 'the gate will not be closed, and campground can still be used for no fee when all amenities are turned off'; current condition 'Will remain open until Thursday (9/24/26)'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: The Forest Service page says the site has 'access to water' and that water is turned off at closure, but its amenity block says 'Potable water is not available at this site.'

facilities.source: FS page ('a single-unit vault toilet'; 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.' vs 'access to water' / 'Campground will have water turned off'), read 2026-11-20

note: Small Bridger-Teton NF campground in lodgepole pine just off US-26/287 in Buffalo Valley, about 8 mi east of Moran; the Buffalo Fork of the Snake River (Wild and Scenic) is a few hundred metres north across the highway. Bear boxes; food storage rules apply. Busy with hunters in the fall. --Claude
